summary: Congratulations claps both hands together a few times in front of the chest, like a handshake with yourself. Big smile required.
steps: Bring both open hands together in front of your chest as if shaking hands with yourself.
Shake them together two or three times.
Smile. This sign without a smile looks like a business handshake.
mistakes: Clapping with flat palms. The hands clasp, like a handshake, rather than slap together.
